The result was Huyang…I thought David was perfect for the part and he did not disappoint. He delivered a performance which impressed even the Master himself, George Lucas.|Dave Filoni|}} '''David Tennant''' (born '''David John McDonald''' on [[April 18]], [[1971]]) is a [[Wikipedia:Scotland|Scottish]] actor and voice actor. He rose to prominence through appearing in the British science fiction television series [[Wikipedia:Doctor Who|''Doctor Who'']] as the [[Wikipedia:Tenth Doctor|tenth]] and [[Wikipedia:Fourteenth Doctor|fourteenth]] incarnations of [[Wikipedia:The Doctor (Doctor Who)|the Doctor]]. A ''[[Star Wars]]'' fan since childhood, Tennant was offered the role of the [[droid]] [[Huyang]] in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' by the series' supervising director and ''Doctor Who'' fan [[Dave Filoni]]. Tennant's voice appeared in two episodes which aired in [[2012]]: "[[A Test of Strength]]" and "[[A Necessary Bond]]." His performance impressed Filoni and ''Star Wars'' creator [[George Lucas]], and was also recognized with the [[Wikipedia:Daytime Emmy Award for Outstanding Performer in an Animated Program|Daytime Emmy Award for Outstanding Performer in an Animated Program]]. Tennant voiced the character again in [[2023]] for the live-action [[Disney+]] series [[Star Wars: Ahsoka|''Ahsoka'']]. As Huyang was portrayed through the use of props, Tennant recorded an early version of the droid's dialogue to allow the other actors to more effectively interact with his character. He returned once more in [[2024]] for the Disney+ animated series [[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures|''Young Jedi Adventures'']] episode "[[Nubs's Big Mistake]]." ==Biography== ===''Doctor Who''=== {{Quote|David Tennant is a ''Star Wars'' fan. You could get him to do a voiceover on ''The Clone Wars''.''"
"''Oh he is? Wow, well, you never know. That's not a bad idea!|Jonathan Wilkins and Dave Filoni, in an interview for ''Star Wars Insider''|{{InsiderCite|125|Dave Filoni: Clone Ranger!}}}} [[File:David_Tennant_Anakin_Skywalker.png|thumb|right|300px|An image of Anakin Skywalker (left) from ''The Clone Wars'' and David Tennant as the Tenth Doctor, foreshadowing the actor's eventual ''Star Wars'' role]] David Tennant is a [[Wikipedia:Scottish people|Scottish]] actor, born as David John McDonald in [[Wikipedia:Bathgate|Bathgate]], [[Wikipedia:Scotland|Scotland]] on [[April 18]], [[1971]]. Tennant saw the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] in its theatrical run at six years old and became "obsessed" afterwards, a feeling he believed continued into adulthood.{{YouTube|video=moyv8PdemSg|text=David Tennant remembers secretly meeting Catherine Tate on Doctor Who | My Film Firsts with BAFTA|channel=bafta|name=BAFTA|date=2024-02-16|quote=Probably the first film I remember getting obsessed with was ''Star Wars'', the original ''Star Wars'', came out in 1977 so I was six. My Auntie Mary took me… And I became very obsessed with ''Star Wars'' from that moment on, to this day probably.}} He has also named ''Star Wars'' as one of his favourite films.{{YouTube|video=7Ltu0okjuuY|text=Four Favorites with David Tennant|channel=@LetterboxdHQ|name=Letterboxd|date=2025-05-02}} Tennant notably played the role of [[w:c:harrypotter:Bartemius Crouch Junior|Barty Crouch Junior]] in the [[2005]] film [[Wikipedia:Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire (film)|''Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire'']]{{WebCite|url=https://www.wizardingworld.com/features/101-thoughts-we-had-while-watching-goblet-of-fire|text=101 thoughts we had while watching Goblet of Fire for the millionth time|date=2016-06-21|work=[[Wikipedia:Wizarding World Digital|WizardingWorld.com]]|quote=How much do you hate Barty Crouch Jr in this moment? Even lovely David Tennant's face can't change that.|archivedate=20230918161503}} and rose in popularity for portraying the [[Wikipedia:Tenth Doctor|tenth incarnation]] of [[Wikipedia:The Doctor (Doctor Who)|the Doctor]] in the British science fiction television series [[Wikipedia:Doctor Who|''Doctor Who'']] from 2005 to [[2010]]. He additionally voiced the character in two animated serials: [[Wikipedia:The Infinite Quest|''The Infinite Quest'']] and [[Wikipedia:Dreamland (Doctor Who)|''Dreamland'']].{{WebCite|url=https://shop.bbc.com/products/doctor-who-the-animation-collection-22136|text=Doctor Who: The Animation Collection|work=[[Wikipedia:BBC Shop|BBC Shop]]|quote=Dreamland and The Infinite Quest with Tenth Doctor David Tennant are your tickets to wild adventures in the American West in search of a legendary lost spaceship.|archivedate=20230325102149}} [[Dave Filoni]], supervising director of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', was introduced to ''Doctor Who'' by his wife, [[E. Anne Convery]], and the couple especially enjoyed Tennant's time in the series and his interactions with his companion [[Wikipedia:Rose Tyler|Rose Tyler]].{{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/2013/03/07/star-wars-the-clone-wars-supervising-director-dave-filonis-season-5-wrap-up-discussion|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars - Dave Filoni Looks Back at Season 5|author=Goldman, Eric|date=2013-03-07|work=[[Wikipedia:IGN|''IGN'']]|archivedate=20231203092051}} Filoni mentioned his enjoyment of ''Doctor Who'' in an [[Dave Filoni: Clone Ranger!|interview]] with [[Jonathan Wilkins]] for the [[Star Wars Insider 125|one hundred and twenty-fifth issue]] of the magazine ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'', first published to [[Wikipedia:United States|United States]] newsstands on [[April 26]], [[2011]].[[Star Wars Insider 124|''Star Wars Insider'' 124]] Wilkins mentioned that Tennant was a ''Star Wars'' fan and could do a voice role on ''The Clone Wars'', which Filoni commented was "not a bad idea" as he had admired the range and intensity Tennant had demonstrated as the Doctor. The issue of ''Insider'' also featured an image of Tennant in his ''Doctor Who'' costume standing back to back with a 3D model of the character [[Anakin Skywalker]] from ''The Clone Wars''. ===''The Clone Wars''=== {{Quote|I just absolutely loved what David Tennant was doing with Doctor Who. There was such a quizzical nature to the character, a sense of whimsy but it could still get very powerful emotion out of the character, a lot of intensity, a lot of anger you know, just such a great display of range.|Dave Filoni, on Tennant's acting qualities that led to his casting as Huyang|{{SW|url=video/from-mcquarrie-to-tennant-creating-huyang|series=Clone Wars Download|text=From McQuarrie to Tennant: Creating Huyang}}}} [[File:Huyang-ATOS.png|thumb|left|250px|David Tennant first voiced Huyang (pictured) in two episodes of ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars''.]] Filoni later said that he knew he had to contact Tennant to discuss a role upon discovering his ''Star Wars'' fandom, as he found that actors who were fans of ''Star Wars'' were more likely to accept roles in ''The Clone Wars''. He enjoyed the idea of merging the "fan-worlds" of ''Doctor Who'' and ''Star Wars'' and hoped to have a high quality role with which to entice Tennant. After Filoni and writer [[Christian Taylor]] created the character of [[Huyang]], an ancient [[droid]] that assists [[Jedi Initiate|younglings]] in constructing their [[lightsaber]]s, the role was offered to Tennant, who accepted. Filoni described Tennant as both "perfect" and "magic" in the role{{InsiderCite|140|Unexpected Journeys}} and stated that his performance had impressed ''Star Wars'' creator [[George Lucas]], who especially enjoyed Huyang's interactions with the [[Astromech droid|droid]] [[R2-D2]]. The four episode arc that featured Huyang spanned the sixth to the ninth episodes of the series's [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]]. The episodes were titled “[[The Gathering (episode)|The Gathering]],” “[[A Test of Strength]],” “[[Bound for Rescue]],” and “[[A Necessary Bond]];”''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]'' and all four were combined into an 80 minute film titled "Young Jedi" which was screened for adolescent audiences at [[Celebration VI]] on [[August 25]], [[2012]].{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/latestnews/story/CVI_TCW_Young_Jedi_Arc_Previewed_147724.asp|text=CVI: ''TCW'' "Young Jedi" Arc Previewed on TheForce.net|author=Eric|archivedate=20190730010724}} Writer [[Pablo Hidalgo]] alluded to Tennant's casting{{InsiderCite|138|Launchpad|Launch Pad}} in the official [[Star Wars Blog|''Star Wars'' Blog]] on a post made on [[October 24]], 2012. He stated that an "amazing" guest star was featured in the episodes, and was surprised to find that the actor's role had not been reported elsewhere, attributing it to Tennant embodying the role so well that he was unrecognizable.{{SW|url=news/whats-inside-star-wars-insider-137|text=What's Inside ''Star Wars Insider'' #137|quote=And they feature an amazing guest star that – much to my surprise – has not been reported anywhere since the Celebration VI screening. I guess he filled the role that well that no one guessed who he is…|nolive=1}} [[File:Tennant_emmy.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Daytime Emmy Award won by Tennant for voicing Huyang.]] Tennant's casting was widely revealed in an article published on StarWars.com on [[November 7]], 2012, which also included a preview clip from Huyang's debut in "A Test of Strength," which premiered on [[November 10]], 2012. The character appeared but did not have any dialogue in "Bound for Rescue"{{TCW|Bound for Rescue}} (aired [[November 17]], 2012), and was voiced by Tennant again in{{TCW|A Necessary Bond}} "A Necessary Bond" (aired [[November 24]], 2012). The "[[Launchpad]]" department of [[Star Wars Insider 138|''Star Wars Insider'' 138]], published on [[December 11]], 2012,[[Star Wars Insider 137|''Star Wars Insider'' 137]] reprinted a portion of Filoni's earlier ''Insider'' to take credit for inspiring Tennant's casting. For his performance, Tennant was nominated for the [[Wikipedia:Daytime Emmy Award for Outstanding Performer in an Animated Program|Daytime Emmy Award for Outstanding Performer in an Animated Program]] at the [[Wikipedia:40th Daytime Creative Arts Emmy Awards|40th Daytime Creative Arts Emmy Awards]]. Two other actors from ''The Clone Wars'' were nominated: [[Jim Cummings]] for his portrayal of [[Hondo Ohnaka]] and [[Sam Witwer]] for his portrayal of [[Maul|Darth Maul]]. The nominations were announced on [[May 1]], [[2013]]{{WebCite|url=http://www.emmyonline.org/mediacenter/daytime_40th_nominations.html|text=The National Academy of Television Arts & Sciences Announces the 40th Annual Daytime Entertainment Emmy Award Nominations|date=2013-05-01|work=[[Wikipedia:National Academy of Television Arts and Sciences|National Academy of Television Arts and Sciences]]|archivedate=20130606100958|nolive=1}} and Tennant won the award at the ceremony on [[June 14]], 2013.{{WebCite|url=http://64.13.227.18/mediacenter/_pdf/day_1213_creative_arts_winners_v02.pdf|text=The National Academy of Television Arts & Sciences Announces Winners for the 40th Annual Daytime Entertainment Creative Arts Emmy Awards|date=2013-06-14|format=PDF|work=[[Wikipedia:National Academy of Television Arts and Sciences|National Academy of Television Arts and Sciences]]|archivedate=20181207045659|nolive=1}} Filoni was delighted at Tennant's win and made a congratulatory [[Wikipedia:Facebook|Facebook]] post in response.{{Facebook|username=DaveFiloni|url=DaveFiloni/photos/a.241263300052/10151632678620053|name=[[Dave Filoni]]|date=2013-06-15|quote=I am very excited to report that David Tennant has won an Emmy for his portrayal of Huyang in Clone Wars. David is a lifelong Star Wars fan and he has definately made an indellible mark on the Star Wars universe that generations of fans will enjoy for years to come. Thank you David, the Force is strong with you.|archivefile=File:David_Tennant_emmy.png}} ===Later career, ''Ahsoka'', and ''Young Jedi Adventures''=== {{Quote|Doctor who? He's a professor.|The caption accompanying a character poster portraying Huyang for the streaming series ''Ahsoka''|{{ThisWeek|c6ucOrXB5Js|Dispatch: Ahsoka Has Arrived|sw_url=video/ahsoka-has-arrived-this-week-in-star-wars-dispatch}}}} [[File:HuyangCharacterPoster-AhsokaSeries.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Tennant reprised the role of Huyang (pictured) in the 2023 series ''Ahsoka''.]] In [[2015]], Tennant portrayed the villain [[w:c:marvelcinematicuniverse:Kilgrave|Kilgrave]] in the [[Marvel Comics|Marvel]] [[Netflix]] series [[Wikipedia:Jessica Jones (TV series)|''Jessica Jones'']].{{WebCite|url=https://www.indiewire.com/features/general/why-david-tennant-felt-marvels-jessica-jones-was-a-gamble-worth-taking-45167|text=Why David Tennant Felt 'Marvel's Jessica Jones' Was 'A Gamble Worth Taking'|author=Miller, Liz Shannon|date=2015-12-14|work=[[Wikipedia:IndieWire|IndieWire]]|archivedate=20231227135535}} The ''Star Wars'' novel [[Brotherhood (novel)|''Brotherhood'']] by [[Mike Chen (author)|Mike Chen]], published on [[May 10]], [[2022]]{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/678652/star-wars-brotherhood-by-mike-chen|text=Star Wars: Brotherhood}} included a rumor amongst the members of a [[Jedi]] [[Mill Alibeth's Initiate Clan|Initiate Clan]] that "Professor Huyang was so old that the ancient droid supposedly arrived at the Jedi Temple in a big blue box thousands of years ago."[[Brotherhood (novel)|''Brotherhood'']] In ''Doctor Who'', the Doctor—played by Tennant amongst other actors—is an ancient being{{WebCite|url=https://screenrant.com/doctor-who-each-version-age-how-old|text=Doctor Who: How Old Every Version Of The Doctor Is|author=Morrison, Matt|date=2020-08-20|work=[[Wikipedia:Screen Rant|''Screen Rant'']]|archivedate=20221107232331}} who travels in a [[Wikipedia:TARDIS|time machine]] that looks like a blue [[Wikipedia:Police box|police box]] from the [[1960s]].{{WebCite|url=https://www.doctorwho.tv/characters/the-tardis|text=The TARDIS|work=[[Wikipedia:BBC|BBC]]: Doctor Who|quote=The TARDIS is the Doctor's ship, their home and their friend. It has been the one constant through all their lives; an impossible blue box, bigger on the inside than the outside, taking them not necessarily to where they wants to go, but very often where they need to be. It can reach any time or place, and with it the Doctor has shown the universe to a rich variety of companions. […] The TARDIS has a chameleon circuit which should allow it to disguise itself, but it seems to have become stuck looking like a tall blue police box from 1960s Earth.|archivedate=20230328065947}} In the same year, Tennant returned to the ''Doctor Who'' franchise in the role of the [[Wikipedia:Fourteenth Doctor|Fourteenth Doctor]], with his [[Wikipedia:The Power of the Doctor|first appearance]] airing on [[October 23]], 2022.{{WebCite|url=https://www.bbc.com/mediacentre/2022/doctor-who-david-tennant-14th-doctor|text=Doctor Who: Here they come…|date=2022-10-23|work=[[Wikipedia:BBC|BBC]]|quote=As Jodie Whittaker's Thirteenth Doctor regenerated on Sunday 23rd October, it was none other than David Tennant who appeared as the Fourteenth Doctor.|archivedate=20230610164847}} Tennant also served as inspiration for [[Tey Sirrek]], a character created for the comic series [[Star Wars: The High Republic (2022)|''Star Wars: The High Republic'' (2022)]]; writer [[Cavan Scott]] envisioned Sirrek as someone who could be played by Tennant, based on his portrayal of the Tenth Doctor.''[[The Art of Star Wars: The High Republic: Volume II]]'' Tennant reprised his role as Huyang for the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]'',{{SW|url=news/swce-2023-ahsoka-panel|text=SWCE 2023: 10 Things We Learned from the ''Ahsoka'' Panel}} which started production on [[May 9]], 2022.{{Twitter|starwars|status/1523694289770868737|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Ahsoka, an Original series, starts production today.|archivedate=20220509162150}} As a droid, Huyang was portrayed through props, so Tennant recorded an early version of his dialogue prior to filming so that the other cast members were able to more effectively interact with the character. Tennant's involvement in the series was not publicly confirmed until its first teaser trailer debuted on [[April 7]], [[2023]], at [[Celebration Europe (2023)|Celebration Europe]]. The trailer featured a glimpse of Huyang with one line of dialogue, and Filoni, ''Ahsoka''{{'s}} creator and showrunner, confirmed Tennant was reprising the role. Huyang appeared in the first two episodes of ''Ahsoka''—"[[Part One: Master and Apprentice]]" and "[[Part Two: Toil and Trouble]]"—which premiered simultaneously on [[August 22]], 2023.{{SW|url=news/ahsoka-new-premiere-date|text=''Ahsoka'' Premiere Moves Up to Tuesday, August 22|date=2023-08-18|quote=The two-episode premiere of ''Ahsoka'' will now arrive on Tuesday, August 22 at 6 p.m. PT on Disney+}} A YouTube short featuring character posters for the series, including Huyang, was released on [[August 24]], and included a caption that alluded to the character's ''Doctor Who'' connection by stating "Doctor who? He's a professor." Tennant voiced Huyang in every episode of the show's [[Ahsoka Season 1|first season]],{{Ahsoka|Part Three: Time to Fly}}{{Ahsoka|Part Four: Fallen Jedi}}{{Ahsoka|Part Five: Shadow Warrior}}{{Ahsoka|Part Six: Far, Far Away}}{{Ahsoka|Part Seven: Dreams and Madness}} which aired weekly until the finale, "[[Part Eight: The Jedi, the Witch, and the Warlord]]"{{Ahsoka|Part Eight: The Jedi, the Witch, and the Warlord}} debuted on [[October 3]], 2023.{{Twitter|starwars|status/1692552080764887366|Star Wars|date=2023-08-18|quote=.Thank you to all the fans who celebrated with us at our @AhsokaOfficial fan events around the world last night! We're excited to announce that new episodes of #Ahsoka will now launch Tuesdays at 6PM PT, starting with our two-episode premiere on August 22, only on @DisneyPlus.|archivedate=20230818152836}} The actor later reprised his role in "[[Nubs's Big Mistake]]," the first part of the [[Nubs's Big Mistake / The Jedi Rescue|fourth episode]] in the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''{{'s}} [[Young Jedi Adventures Season Two|second season]],{{YJA|Nubs's Big Mistake}} which aired on Disney+ on [[August 14]], [[2024]].{{SW|url=news/young-jedi-adventures-season-2-and-nubs-shorts|text=''Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures'' Returns for Season 2}} ==Works== ===Filmography=== {|{{Prettytable}} !
